menu.neospuppets.sowing.title: Sowing Table
tooltip.neospuppets.puppet_manipulator.c:
§6When right clicked:
 §fWhen in main hand:
  §7Changes the pose of a puppet.
 §fWhen in off hand:
  §7Rotates puppet clockwise.
§6When left clicked in main hand
 §fWhen standing:
  §7Pastes copied pose to puppet.
 §fWhen crouching:
  §7Copies puppet's pose to clipboard.
